sections.Profile:
Little Chief is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronics in September 1975. Designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche, this game features a Western theme and is equipped with two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, a standup target, and a kick-out hole. A unique aspect of Little Chief is its mid-field ball return gate, adding an extra layer of strategy to the gameplay.
